cohort: The study included 220 adolescent mothers from the Limbe Health District of Cameroon.
finding: The prevalence of adverse teenage pregnancy outcomes was 34.8%, with caesarean delivery (20.9%), preterm delivery (12.7%), low birth weight (19.5%), and neonatal mortality (9.1%) being the main adverse outcomes, and various determinants were identified for each specific outcome.
mod_finding: Caesarean delivery accounted for 20.9% of adverse outcomes, with drug use, premature delivery, and physical exercise identified as its determinants.
